Enum FieldQuery.FieldListType

  • Object
    • Enum<FieldQuery.FieldListType>
      • FieldQuery.FieldListType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<FieldQuery.FieldListType>
    Enclosing class:
    FieldQuery

    public static enum FieldQuery.FieldListType
extends Enum<FieldQuery.FieldListType>
    Type of field list to be queried. tableName must be given appropriately, e.g it must refer to an infosystem if field list type is INFOSYS_FIELDS.
